findings: No network access, subprocess, eval/exec or dynamic imports in blender/*.py or tests/asset-factory.test.js. The scripts import only bpy, mathutils, the stdlib (sys, pathlib, math) and sibling modules, so no external assets are loaded (spec S6).
File writes go only to ROOT/assets and ROOT/evidence, with fixed names derived from module names. No user-controlled paths.
package.json: only the test glob changed, to "tests/**/*.test.js". It adds no dependencies and no install scripts.
Minor, non-blocking: build_all.py puts the blender/ directory first on sys.path, so a future file named like a stdlib module would shadow it. No current filename collides.
The review is written to reviews/wo-gh-1-reviewer-security.md. I did not run the scripts or tests; this is a static read of the code.
